project.name: SceneLedger
project.summary: A source-first production research agent that uses Gemini 3.8 Flash to plan and synthesize, Parallel Search to retrieve live evidence, and deterministic citation checks to preserve uncertainty.
project.ai_usage: Gemini 3.8 Flash on Google Cloud Agent Platform plans factual questions and synthesizes the evidence ledger. Parallel Search provides the only external evidence supplied to the model.
project.codex_usage: Codex designed and implemented the application, tests, documentation and deployment configuration. Codex is not part of the submitted runtime.
